This repository contains Quarto shortcodes, embedded extensions, and style
theming that is used by all Seedcase Project Quarto-based repositories.

## Installing

To install the extension, use:

```bash
quarto add seedcase-project/seedcase-theme
```

To update the `seedcase-theme`, run:

```bash
quarto update seedcase-project/seedcase-theme
```

## Using

After installing the extension, add the below yaml key-value pair to the
`_quarto.yml` file:

```yaml
format: seedcase-theme-html
```

Or for project-level configurations:

```yaml
project:
  type: seedcase-theme
```

See this repository's
[`_quarto.yml`](https://github.com/{{< meta gh.org >}}/{{< meta gh.repo >}}/blob/main/_quarto.yml)
and
[`index.qmd`](https://github.com/{{< meta gh.org >}}/{{< meta gh.repo >}}/blob/main/index.qmd)
files for examples of how you would use this extension.

### Adding the "A part of Seedcase" badge

Add the following to `_quarto.yml` to show the badge in the navbar:

```yaml
  navbar:
    right:
      - text: "<img src='/_extensions/seedcase-project/seedcase-theme/logos/seedcase/a-part-of.svg' alt='Main Seedcase website' height='30px'>"
        href: "https://seedcase-project.org"
```

It looks like this:

![](/_extensions/seedcase-theme/logos/seedcase/a-part-of.svg){alt-text="Image with the Seedcase logo and the text 'A part of Seedcase'."}
